verdict.rationale: Claude provides user-facing data export (Settings > Privacy) of conversation and account data, incognito chats that are excluded from model training, memory/chat-search features that can be reviewed, edited, or turned off, and enterprise-level audit logs plus a compliance API for org-wide data governance. Together these give users concrete control over retention, deletion, and data usage. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a self-serve 'delete my account/conversation data' deletion flow or retention-period specifics, and no independent/hands-on verification of deletion actually occurring.
